summary: Destructor for a config/command-binding object. Copies the stored handle from a global command-binding table, resets a shared string buffer, optionally reports vehicle statistics, frees a linked list of nodes (each node: data pointer, next pointer, flag byte), clears the list head/tail/count fields, and reinserts a sentinel default entry into the custom command list.

operations.description: Copy the stored command-binding handle: this+0x104 = dword_7C7368[this+0x108], using the field at this+0x108 as an index into the global table dword_7C7368.
Reset the shared string buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on byte_5EA438.
When the scene-destroyed flag byte_7C7064 is clear, report the vehicle statistics held in byte_7C56C0 during teardown.
Walk the node list starting at this+0x44 while the current node pointer is nonzero; each node carries a data pointer at node+0 and the next pointer at node+4.
Per node, test the flag byte at node+8; when set, free the node's inner data allocation chain.
Free the node's inner data pointer chain (the data block and the data block pointer) via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null.
Free the node block itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Clear the list bookkeeping fields this+0x44, this+0x48, this+0x4C and this+0x50 to 0.
Reinsert a sentinel/default entry named aCustom_0 into the custom command list via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aCustom_0, -1).
